_note: The list of CORE VIEW PAGES the launcher shows (user ruling 2026-09-21, retrieval-linkage audit finding F-4: core overview pages sat scattered inside their tools, so the user forgot they existed). This file is the only thing to edit: an entry points at a page where it already lives — pages are never moved or copied (they are the launcher's 'profiles'). Writers: an agent PROPOSES an entry, the user approves; build.py only reads. `title` is the FUNCTION name in the user's words (what the page is for), not the file's task name. `refresh` is the command that regenerates the page, shown with a copy button; empty when unknown — never guessed. At most 1-2 entries per project, so the launcher stays a front door and not a second file browser. Groups render in the order of `groups`.
_share_template: SHARE TEMPLATE: the source environment's register is reduced to its schema plus one worked example row. Replace <CLAUDE_HOME> with your config directory, or delete the row and add your own pages. Until then the row reads as a missing file (greyed, with its refresh command) -- the designed behaviour for a pinned page that does not exist yet. Add groups, sidebar entries and families as your own projects need them.

sidebar._note: How the SIDEBAR groups projects (user ruling 2026-09-21: the flat recency-sorted list was the page's worst clutter; groups reuse the dashboard's `groups`, order is STABLE = the order written here, one nesting level for a project family, frozen/done/maintenance and unregistered projects collapse at the bottom). Order inside a group = list order below; a registered project not listed falls back by root (under ~/.claude -> fallback.under_home, else fallback.other) and sorts after the listed ones. Writers: agent proposes, user approves; build.py only reads.
